deployments_detail.use: IR generative-AI assistant: Tokyu Corporation adopted ExaWizards' 'exaBase IR Assistant' to auto-generate anticipated Q&A for earnings briefings, shareholder meetings and press conferences, and to create IR reference materials and meeting records for its Finance Strategy Division. [ExaWizards (exaBase IR Assistant / Exa Enterprise AI)]

Generative-AI automation of accounting voucher (journal) entry: Tokyu links NTT Data's Biz-integral ERP with WingArc1st's 'dejiren AI' so AI reads invoices, drafts vouchers referencing past entries, and validates accounting classifications, with staff review via chat. Verified in a FY2025 pilot; considering expansion across Tokyu Group. [NTT Data Biz Integral (Biz∫ ERP), WingArc1st (dejiren AI)]
deployments_detail.value: up to 38% work reduction in voucher entry; target ~5,000 work-hours/year saved

deployments_detail.use: AI image analysis for crossing/station danger detection; "Spot" robot inspection (claimed Japan rail-industry first permanent deployment, Apr 2025); AI+LiDAR track intrusion detection

Onboard forward-monitoring obstacle/person detection: cameras and LiDAR mounted on a 1000-series train feed video and 3D point-cloud data to AI image analysis to detect obstacles and people on the track. Trial on the Ikegami and Tamagawa lines. [none]

AI image-analysis on existing station and level-crossing cameras to detect hazardous behavior (e.g., prolonged loitering at crossings) and support driver/station-staff operations, with alerts to the rail operations center. Trial along the Toyoko Line (Todoroki area crossing and all Toyoko Line stations). [none]

Local 5G + AI track-inspection experiment: high-definition front-of-train cameras transmit footage over Local 5G to AI servers that analyze rail equipment for abnormalities, aiming to replace hours-long manual patrols with minutes of targeted checks. Tokyu Railway participates on the Toyoko Line (Shibuya-Yokohama, ~24.2km). [Sumitomo Corporation (lead); multi-operator consortium]
deployments_detail.value: target ~90%+ abnormality detection per run; 100% across multiple daily runs

deployments_detail.use: WANDER COMPASS Shibuya remote-service point: AI guidance signage with a voice-interactive chatbot (Nextremer) answers common questions (station directions, transfers) and a travel-diagnosis feature (Huber.) proposes personalized itineraries, alongside remote video staff assistance, in Japanese and English at Shibuya Station. [Nextremer (AI guidance chatbot), Huber. (travel diagnosis)]

Chuo-Rinkan station remote guidance/settlement trial: avatar-style AI guidance terminal ('TAZUNE') provides a chatbot interface for station inquiries plus remote video staff support and remote IC-card processing, testing non-contact station operations at the Den-en-toshi Line ticket window. [Panasonic Connect (TAZUNE)]

AI security at railway stations: Asilla behavior-recognition AI ('AI Security asilla' / TS-Zero) analyzes existing station CCTV to detect abnormal behavior (falls, fights, intrusion) and alert security operators. Launched in commercial service at Tana and Tsukimino stations on the Den-en-toshi Line; Tokyu took a capital/business stake in Asilla. [Asilla (AI Security asilla), Tokyu Security (TS-Zero)]

Expansion of Asilla behavior-recognition AI security to major Shibuya commercial facilities (Shibuya Stream, Shibuya Hikarie, Shibuya Axsh): 'AI Security asilla' analyzes existing camera footage 24/7 to detect suspicious/abnormal behavior, following the deepened Tokyu-Asilla capital and business alliance. [Asilla (AI Security asilla)]
deployments_detail.value: ~100 patrol-hours/month reduction cited at a related Shibuya property using the same tech
